title: IT Change Request Workflow
context: You are a Business Analyst at a FCA-regulated financial services firm. The firm needs a BPMN diagram for their IT Change Request process. All changes must be reviewed by IT, Risk, and the Change Advisory Board (CAB) before being deployed to production. Audit trails are mandatory for regulatory compliance (FCA SYSC and GDPR).
instructions: Model the IT Change Request process as a BPMN diagram. Include the following: lanes for IT, Risk, and CAB; exclusive gateways for approval decisions; a review subprocess with error boundary handling; at least one task with audit keywords (review, approve, record); and default paths on all exclusive gateways.

required_elements.description: At least 3 lanes for IT, Risk, CAB
At least 2 exclusive gateways for approval decisions
A review subprocess for the change assessment
At least 3 tasks across the process

required_patterns.description: Every subprocess must have an error boundary event (regulatory requirement)
All exclusive gateways must have a default path
At least one task must be audit-relevant (log, record, evidence, notify, confirm, approve, review)
Diagram must have at least 2 lanes (multi-stakeholder)
All flow objects must have valid connections
Diagram must have one start event and at least one end event

forbidden_antipatterns.description: All exclusive gateways must have a default path

partial_credit_rules.feedback: At least one structural pattern is correct

feedback_messages.pass: Your IT Change Request diagram meets all requirements. It properly handles approvals, exceptions, and audit compliance.
feedback_messages.fail: Your diagram needs revision. Review the regulatory requirements for gateways, error handling, and audit trails.
feedback_messages.partial: Good progress. Focus on the missing elements and patterns listed above.
